reason: The automatic Fishtest-derived schedule barely moved any degraded start and did not recover Elo.
The replacement schedule was selected from update-size diagnostics, not from held-out match results.
All three replacement trajectories restarted from their declared degraded points.
hygiene: An accidental duplicate launch contaminated the first replacement attempt.
Those games and states were archived and excluded before clean trajectories restarted.
The clean runs retain the original engine, spaces, seeds, openings, time control, and game budget.
Results are reported as a follow-up method, not as the preregistered SPSA arm.
